node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only — a seeded BTCUSDT book (seed 503): tick 0.10 and qty step 0.001 from the recorded instrument fixture; mark 64,560.2 at t0; 500 levels a side; sizes, walls, stops, the own orders and the viewing-as user "Manager 01" are synthetic; cost and clamp figures are a kit model, illustrative, PROPOSED, not a budget. No real account identifier, key or balance. The env badge reads the session environment (DEMO here), never the feed (C-2.11).

kids.chars: §0 L111: SCR-051/tier-change-pending, SCR-051/saving, SCR-051/rebuild-refused, SCR-051/500-unavailable; D02's tier notice inset

kids.name: value-2

kids.chars: Frames 1280 × 800 windows; the dialog (CMP-043 lg) at comfortable density over SCR-050 at compact (§0)

kids.name: value-6

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §10 L301 SCR-051/tier-change-pending: signal a book key changed, not saved; shows W-4 under the control; the tile at the new tier; keyboard focus stays on the control; announced W-4 polite once (R-5); T2 none

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: 200 → 500 picked, not saved: a book key (R-2), so W-4 shows under the group at once, as plain text in the tabpanel; the tile already shows the 500 sample (R-1); nothing applies to the panel before Save

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Tile at 500: each band sums 100 levels; stops 197.608, 288.246, 359.573, 589.643, 760.558 BTC (adaptive)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: A second book key changed in the same session does not repeat W-4 (R-5: an equal queued message is dropped)

value-1.chars: §10 L302 SCR-051/saving: signal Save pressed, ctl_ok pending; shows Save loading, aria-disabled; fields aria-disabled; body aria-busy; keyboard focus stays on Save (never disabled); announced W-38 polite once (R-5); T2 none

value-2.chars: Save validated, the ctl sent: CMP-043 busy until ctl_ok (23:719); Save keeps focus with aria-disabled="true" (never disabled), the body aria-busy="true", every field aria-disabled="true" (§8.2)

value-3.chars: The status node writes W-38 once (R-5); no answer within the client's request timeout (G-6) ends the busy state and §8.3 applies with W-9

value-4.chars: On ctl_ok the dialog closes, focus returns to the opener (else the panel's depth control, else the pane), the panel shows D02's tier notice (the inset); dom.depth_tier_changed fires on this Save (§14.1), with dom.settings_changed {key} per changed key

value-1.chars: §10 L303 SCR-051/rebuild-refused: signal resync_rate_limited or the cap at Save; shows W-9 inline under the Save row; values kept; keyboard focus moves to W-9 (tabindex="-1"); announced read on focus; T2 none (T4)

value-2.chars: resync_rate_limited (23:731) or the deep-book cap (23:765) at Save: nothing changes; the dialog stays, the values are kept, the busy state ends (§8.3)

value-3.chars: W-9 inline under the Save row with focus moved to it (tabindex="-1", no role="alert": focus reads it); T4 at the point of action, not T2

value-4.chars: W-9 is the key book.rebuild_refused: PROPOSED for E17-D01 §7's owner (D03E17:211 routes the refused-ctl copy there)

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: §10 L304 SCR-051/500-unavailable: signal flag off or a cap; shows the 500 radio with W-3, 2a; keyboard arrow-reachable, focused without being checked; Space re-shows W-3 (G-T2.3); announced W-3 each press (R-5 T2 rule); T2 the 500 option, 2a (§3.2)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: heatmap_depth_500 off (24:5615) or a cap: the 500 radio is T2 in rendering 2a (R-3): in the group, aria-disabled="true", never disabled, the CMP-019 lock leading the label, W-3 under the option (43 characters) in the DOM at mount via aria-describedby, the well color.surface.raised + color.border.default

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Arrowing lands on the 500 radio and focuses it without checking it: 200 stays checked; Space / Enter re-shows W-3 with one polite announcement (G-T2.3)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: W-3 is D02's key book.tier_unavailable, the same key (C-13): PROPOSED, vocabulary owner E09-D09 #192, "if #5488 merges as is"; OQ-1: a cap from E21-K01 #603 makes this the default, no redraw
